title: Log Export Integration Request
description: Request schema for creating or updating a log integration.

logTypes.description: Array of log types exported by this integration.

type.description: Type of log integration. Identifies which service will receive the exported logs. This value cannot be modified after the integration is created.

prefixPath.description: Path prefix where the log files will be stored. Atlas will add further sub-directories based on the log type.

roleId.description: Unique 24-character hexadecimal string that identifies the Atlas Cloud Provider Access role.

storageAccountName.description: Storage account name where logs will be stored.

storageContainerName.description: Storage container name for log files.

type.description: Human-readable label that identifies the service to which you want to integrate with Atlas. The value must match the log integration type. This value cannot be modified after the integration is created.
